request: My father is 64. Does he get any discount on Deccan Rail?
answer: Passenger Help Desk here. According to our rules, passengers aged 60 or over receive a 40 per cent discount on the adult fare. Proof of age must be shown when boarding. Since your father is 64, he should be eligible for this discount.
